description: Physicochemical comparison of the active-site pocket shell across characterised PncC, PP_1628, PP_3298 and the inactive YdeJ
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"}
aa3to1={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
        'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def parse(txt):
    at=[]
    for ln in txt.split("\n"):
        if ln.startswith("ATOM"):
            at.append((ln[12:16].strip(),ln[17:20].strip(),ln[21],int(ln[22:26]),
                       float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])))
    return pd.DataFrame(at,columns=['name','res','ch','num','x','y','z'])
MOD={}
for acc in ['Q88HQ5','Q88ME5','P0A6G3','P31131']:
    MOD[acc]=parse(requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-{acc}-F1-model_v6.pdb",headers=H,timeout=120).text)
MOD['2A9S']=parse(requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/2A9S.pdb",headers=H,timeout=120).text)

SPEC={'2A9S'  :dict(label='A. fabrum PncC (2A9S, X-ray)', ch='A', S=31,Y=58,K=63,R=145, cls='characterised PncC family'),
      'P0A6G3':dict(label='E. coli PncC (AF2)',           ch='A', S=29,Y=56,K=61,R=142, cls='active NMN deamidase'),
      'Q88ME5':dict(label='PP_1628 (AF2)',                ch='A', S=27,Y=54,K=59,R=139, cls='canonical PncC ortholog'),
      'Q88HQ5':dict(label='PP_3298 (AF2)',                ch='A', S=25,Y=52,K=57,R=139, cls='test protein'),
      'P31131':dict(label='E. coli YdeJ (AF2)',           ch='A', S=40,Y=67,K=72,R=152, cls='no NMN deamidase activity')}
ATN={'S':'OG','Y':None,'K':'NZ','R':None}
POS=+1; NEG=-1
charge={'R':1,'K':1,'D':-1,'E':-1,'H':0.1}
polar=set('STNQYCHW')
rows=[]; detail={}
for acc,sp in SPEC.items():
    d=MOD[acc]; d=d[d.ch==sp['ch']]
    # centroid uses CZ/OH/NZ/OG where present, else side-chain centroid of that residue
    pts=[]
    for lab,nm in [('S','OG'),('Y','OH'),('K','NZ'),('R','CZ')]:
        sel=d[(d.num==sp[lab])&(d.name==nm)]
        if len(sel)==0:  # YdeJ has Phe/Cys at Y/R positions
            sc=d[(d.num==sp[lab])&(~d.name.isin(['N','CA','C','O']))]
            pts.append(sc[['x','y','z']].values.mean(axis=0))
        else: pts.append(sel[['x','y','z']].values[0])
    cen=np.mean(pts,axis=0)
    sc=d[~d.name.isin(['N','CA','C','O'])]
    dist=np.linalg.norm(sc[['x','y','z']].values-cen,axis=1)
    inshell=sorted(set(sc.num.values[dist<9.0]))
    res1=[]
    for n in inshell:
        r=d[(d.num==n)&(d.name=='CA')]
        if len(r): res1.append((n,aa3to1.get(r.res.iloc[0],'X')))
    letters=[a for _,a in res1]
    natoms=int((dist<9.0).sum())
    net=sum(charge.get(a,0) for a in letters)
    rows.append(dict(structure=sp['label'], classification=sp['cls'], n_residues=len(res1),
                     sidechain_atoms_in_shell=natoms,
                     Arg_Lys=sum(a in 'RK' for a in letters), Asp_Glu=sum(a in 'DE' for a in letters),
                     net_charge=round(net,1), polar_frac=round(np.mean([a in polar for a in letters]),2),
                     hydrophobic_frac=round(np.mean([a in set('AVLIMFWPG') for a in letters]),2)))
    detail[sp['label']]="".join(f"{a}{n} " for n,a in res1)
T=pd.DataFrame(rows); pd.set_option('display.width',240)
print(T.to_string(index=False))
print()
for k,v in detail.items(): print(f"{k}:\n  {v}\n")
T.to_csv('pocket_physicochemistry.csv',index=False)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(14,4.3))
order=list(T.structure); x=np.arange(len(T))
cols=['#777777','#3b6ea5','#3b6ea5','#c4622d','#8c8c3a']
for ax,(col,title,ylab) in zip(axes,[('net_charge','Net formal charge of the pocket shell','net charge'),
                                     ('Arg_Lys','Basic residues (Arg + Lys) in the pocket shell','count'),
                                     ('sidechain_atoms_in_shell','Side-chain heavy atoms within 9 angstrom','atom count')]):
    ax.bar(x,T[col],color=cols)
    ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([s.replace(' (','\n(') for s in order],fontsize=7.5,rotation=20,ha='right')
    ax.set_title(title,fontsize=10); ax.set_ylabel(ylab)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
